name: Escape from The Temple of Nepenthe
source:
It's a game about an alien anthropologist and her pilot exploring an abandoned planet with many legends and mysteries surrounding it, and strange architecture.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11584]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一名外星人类学家与她的飞行员探索一颗废弃行星。那里流传着众多传说，隐藏着无数谜团，还有各种奇异建筑。

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11584]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
